_meta.source: data/labels.json (DailyMed SPL; shared records fetched 2026-10-05/06, cervical additions 2026-10-06)
_meta.use: Applied to every regimen that contains the drug, in addition to the regimen's own trial-specific risk_rules.

effects.exclude: label §4 contraindication, or a label instruction not to start
effects.caution: a label stop/hold rule the patient's baseline is already close to

_meta.note: Rules for agents fetched by the labels subagent on 2026-10-06 were written from the ranker-facing summary of those labels; verify wording against data/labels.json rules before relying on a section number.

carboplatin.reason: Label: do not repeat until neutrophils ≥2,000 and platelets ≥100,000
Label: CrCl <15 mL/min — data too limited for a dose recommendation

cisplatin.reason: Label: withhold until platelets ≥100,000 and WBC ≥4,000
Label §2.5: consider permanent discontinuation for grade 3–4 neuropathy; baseline G2 leaves little margin
Label: impaired creatinine clearance → consider alternative treatment

paclitaxel.reason: Label: do not treat solid tumours with baseline neutrophils <1,500/mm³
Label Table 17: transaminases ≥10×ULN or bilirubin >5×ULN → not recommended

topotecan.reason: Label: first cycle only if neutrophils ≥1,500 and platelets ≥100,000

ifosfamide.reason: IFEX §2.2: repeat only after recovery from haematologic toxicity

bevacizumab.reason: AVASTIN §2: start ≥28 days after major surgery and when the wound is healed
AVASTIN §2: proteinuria ≥2 g/24 h → withhold; hypertensive crisis → discontinue
GOG-240: fistula of any grade 15% vs 1% — all in previously irradiated patients; grade 3 fistula 6%

pembrolizumab.reason: Checkpoint-inhibitor trials excluded active autoimmune disease; the label has no contraindication
KEYTRUDA §2.3: permanent discontinuation if prednisone cannot be reduced to ≤10 mg/day within 12 weeks

atezolizumab.reason: Checkpoint-inhibitor trials excluded active autoimmune disease; TECENTRIQ §4 lists no contraindication
TECENTRIQ §2: myocarditis or pericarditis G2–4 → permanent discontinuation

durvalumab.reason: Checkpoint-inhibitor trials excluded active autoimmune disease; the label has no contraindication

nivolumab.reason: OPDIVO/YERVOY §2.3: pneumonitis G3–4 → permanent discontinuation of both drugs
Checkpoint-inhibitor trials excluded active autoimmune disease
Combination label: AST/ALT >5×ULN → permanent discontinuation of both
Label: permanent discontinuation if prednisone cannot be reduced to ≤10 mg/day within 12 weeks

trastuzumab_deruxtecan.reason: Label Table 3: LVEF <40% or symptomatic CHF → permanent discontinuation
Label Table 3: any symptomatic (≥G2) ILD → permanent discontinuation

cemiplimab.reason: Checkpoint-inhibitor trials excluded active autoimmune disease; LIBTAYO §4 lists no contraindication

tisotumab_vedotin.reason: TIVDAK boxed warning / §2: ocular toxicity ladder to permanent discontinuation (corneal ulceration, G4 conjunctival or corneal events); innovaTV 301 conjunctivitis 31.2%, keratitis 15.6%
TIVDAK §2: peripheral neuropathy G2 → withhold/reduce, G3–4 → permanent discontinuation; innovaTV 301 sensory neuropathy 28.4%

docetaxel.reason: TAXOTERE §2 / §4: bilirubin > ULN, or AST/ALT >1.5×ULN with ALP >2.5×ULN → do not administer
TAXOTERE §2: severe neurosensory symptoms → reduce dose; persistent → discontinue

vinorelbine.reason: Vinorelbine label §2: do not administer with ANC <1,000 cells/mm³
Vinorelbine label §2: dose reduction for total bilirubin >2 mg/dL

pemetrexed.reason: Pemetrexed label §2: not recommended with CrCl <45 mL/min
Pemetrexed label §2: start a cycle only with ANC ≥1,500 and platelets ≥100,000

gemcitabine.reason: Gemcitabine label §2: day 1 ANC <1,500 or platelets <100,000 → delay
Gemcitabine label §2: unexplained dyspnoea / severe pulmonary toxicity → permanent discontinuation

irinotecan.reason: CAMPTOSAR §2: new cycle only when granulocytes ≥1,500/mm³ and platelets ≥100,000/mm³
CAMPTOSAR §2: dosing cannot be recommended with bilirubin >2 mg/dL
CAMPTOSAR: severe diarrhoea; baseline bowel obstruction is a contraindication (§4)

fluorouracil.reason: Fluorouracil §2.7: cardiac toxicity → withhold, no recommended resumption dose

hydroxyurea.reason: HYDREA §2: do not start with marked bone-marrow depression (WBC <2,500 or platelets <100,000)

mitomycin.reason: Mitomycin §4: thrombocytopenia, coagulation disorder or increased bleeding tendency

vincristine.reason: Vincristine label: neurotoxicity dose-limiting; pre-existing neuromuscular disease is a contraindication class concern

bleomycin.reason: Bleomycin boxed warning: pulmonary fibrosis; pre-existing lung disease

etoposide.reason: Etoposide label §2: withhold for platelets <50,000 or ANC <500; baseline marrow reserve

nab_paclitaxel.reason: ABRAXANE Table 1: AST >10×ULN or bilirubin >5×ULN not recommended
ABRAXANE §2: G3 neuropathy → withhold until ≤G1, reduce

cadonilimab.reason: PD-1/CTLA-4 bispecific: COMPASSION-16 excluded active autoimmune disease; no FDA label
Checkpoint-inhibitor class pneumonitis; no FDA label to cite
